about-line-opacity-offset: A clothing editor with a modern control interface and a dedicated wardrobe UI
about-line-experimental: Skew, mirror, free draw, and single gloves are AEE extensions and require the plugin to display correctly
about-line-customizable: Some features are experimental and may contain errors; disable them when necessary
layering-hide-panel-hint: Choose which groups this item hides. This setting is stored with the item and is compatible with WCE.
settings-right-click-exit-drag: Right-click to exit canvas dragging while editing
settings-hover-tryon-tooltip: Adds a "hover try-on" toggle to the clothing and item menus. When on, hovering an option previews it on the character instantly and restores the original look when you move away; nothing is actually worn.
settings-hair-character-preview-tooltip: Hides the game's own "preview on character" button and lets AEE's character-preview toggle control the clothing slots instead. Hair, eyes, eyebrows and mouth slots always use character previews.
copy-item-tooltip: Copy this piece (colors, offsets, transforms and all settings)
paste-item-tooltip: Paste the copied piece into this slot
copy-cancel-tooltip: Cancel copy and clear the copied piece
settings-hide-arousal-ui: Hide arousal bar and other UI
settings-bc-wheel-scroll: Scroll wheel to page through groups
settings-enable-free-draw-tooltip: Adds appearance slots for free drawing, masking and imported images. Only people who also run AEE with this option on can see them; if the other person doesn't, the slots are hidden.
settings-load-others-font-tooltip: Show other players' item text in the fonts they chose. You also need that font on your device to see it the way they do.
settings-item-font-open-panel: Open the font panel (preview, pick and manage fonts)
settings-item-font-preview-sample: Aa Bb Cc Hello 你好 123
parts-filter-tooltip-all: Showing all groups. Click to show only worn groups
parts-filter-tooltip-has: Showing only worn groups. Click to show only empty groups
parts-filter-tooltip-empty: Showing only empty groups. Click to show all groups
layer-manager-tooltip: Layer manager: list all drawing layers and adjust their priority
hide-restraints-tooltip-off: Restraints shown. Click to hide them in the preview (still worn)
hide-restraints-tooltip-on: Restraints hidden in the preview (still worn). Click to show
background-settings-image-load-tooltip: Use an image URL as the background. The source must allow cross-origin access (CORS); cross-origin images can taint the canvas and break features like the eyedropper until you reload the page
background-settings-image-upload-tooltip: Upload an image from your device as the background. It is stored in the browser's IndexedDB, and uploading again replaces the existing image
menu-export-tooltip: Export the current appearance to the clipboard in BCX format, to share or keep as a backup
menu-import-tooltip: Import a BCX/AEE appearance code from the clipboard; you can choose which categories and items to apply first
import-controller-manual-paste-prompt: [AEE] Paste the appearance code (Ctrl+V), then OK:
import-controller-cannot-parse-clipboard: [AEE] Cannot parse clipboard content (please export with AEE/BCX first)
import-controller-no-diff-alert: [AEE] No slots differ — nothing to import
wardrobe-confirm-save: Save the worn outfit into the selected slot?
wardrobe-confirm-import-slot: Overwrite the selected slot with the clipboard outfit?
wardrobe-capacity-hint: Shares its data with FBCWardrobe, with a 180K limit. The bar shows how much is used
wardrobe-setting-96-slots-hint: Expands the wardrobe to up to 96 slots; all the data together must stay under 180K
wardrobe-sps-about-hint: SPS is an online wardrobe that can be read across servers. Open the official repositories to learn more.
wardrobe-toast-sps-load-failed: Failed to load the SPS wardrobe
wardrobe-toast-sps-save-failed: Failed to sync the SPS wardrobe
wardrobe-revert-tryon: Revert to how you looked on entry
wardrobe-panel-hint-move: Tap two panels to swap their positions.
wardrobe-panel-hint-delete: Tap a panel to hide or restore it (character cards can't be hidden).
wardrobe-panel-hint-idle: Choose Move or Remove to edit the layout.
wardrobe-appearance-hint-1: Click a swatch to apply a preset, or use the color picker for a custom accent.
wardrobe-appearance-hint-2: UI Style changes buttons, panels, borders and glow effects at once.
wardrobe-migration-conflict: Conflicting layer keys, missing asset, or transform cannot be preserved; original data retained.
wardrobe-migration-empty: This wardrobe has no legacy AEE data to migrate.
wardrobe-migration-warning: Legacy data may come from different versions, so the corrected result cannot be guaranteed. Backing up the entire selected wardrobe first is recommended.
wardrobe-migration-failed: Wardrobe migration failed; changes were not completed
wardrobe-import-empty: Nothing loaded. Pick a wardrobe file or paste an outfit code.
wardrobe-import-preview-hint: Pick a change on the left to compare before and after.
wardrobe-confirm-delete: Are you sure you want to delete this outfit? This cannot be undone.
wardrobe-tag-placeholder: New tag, press Enter to add
wardrobe-category-placeholder: New category, press Enter to add
wardrobe-prompt-bg-url:
Enter image URL (http/https).
Note: the source must allow CORS, otherwise it will not display:
free-draw-mask-tooltip: Mask: use this drawing as a shape to hide everything outside the body (click again for plain drawing)
free-draw-symmetry-tooltip: Symmetry drawing (mirror about the canvas centre; not for text or fill)
free-draw-shape-tooltip: Shapes (click to expand and pick a shape)
free-draw-color-tooltip: Color (click to open the AEE color picker)
free-draw-stroke-tooltip: Drag/click the bar to set stroke thickness
free-draw-move-tooltip: Move: click, then drag the whole drawing on the left; or use the arrows below
free-draw-priority-tooltip: Drag to adjust order; higher covers more when masking (only clothing with lower priority is hidden)
free-draw-bounds-tooltip: Show or hide the drawable canvas boundary
free-draw-size-tooltip: Estimated size of this character's ENTIRE appearance (this drawing plus everything else worn) as it would be sent to the server. That message has a size limit, and the closer you get to it, the more likely saving fails or the room desyncs
free-draw-size-danger-tooltip: This character's total appearance is at or over the server's message size limit, so saving may fail or desync the room. This isn't only about this drawing; data from everything else worn counts toward the same limit. Undo recent edits, or simplify or shrink the drawing (imported photos are the usual cause) before applying
free-draw-size-blocked: Cannot save: the projected appearance is 180K or larger. Undo, clear, or simplify the drawing, or cancel these changes.
free-draw-sps-too-large: Upload failed: the final image exceeds 3.3 MB.
free-draw-sps-upload-failed: The SPS image upload failed; the character appearance was not changed.
free-draw-hint: Draw directly on the character; "Move" drags the whole drawing, use the buttons for rotate/scale/mirror; "Mask" uses the drawing as a shape to hide everything outside the body
free-draw-image-tooltip: Import image (file only; drag to move, drag the corner to resize)
free-draw-image-failed: Could not read that image — try another file
free-draw-image-tainted: That image's pixels can't be read; import cancelled
free-draw-image-placed: Drag to move, drag the blue corner to resize. Click outside or Accept to merge it into the drawing
color-picker-eyedropper-taint: Can't pick: the canvas is tainted by a cross-origin image — reload the page and retry.
experimental-feature-tooltip: This is an AEE extension. Only people who also have AEE installed can see the edit effect
free-draw-save-encode-failed: The drawing could not be encoded. Reload the editor and try again.
free-draw-size-upload-prompt: The projected AccountUpdate is {{size}}, above the 160K safety limit. Upload this drawing to SPS instead?
free-draw-sps-adopted: The received drawing was transferred to your SPS storage
free-draw-sps-adopt-failed: The received drawing could not be transferred to your SPS storage
free-draw-library-tooltip: 30-slot SPS drawing library: save, recall and clear drawings you use often
free-draw-mode-tooltip: Embedded data: the drawing is saved inside each outfit and adds to the appearance size. SPS upload: the drawing is uploaded to SPS's public image space and only a reference is saved, which keeps appearance data small
free-draw-library-saved: Drawing saved to the SPS library
free-draw-library-too-large: This drawing exceeds the 2 MB library-slot limit.
free-draw-library-failed: The SPS drawing library operation failed.
settings-hide-unnecessary-appearance-but: Hides the original "random outfit", "random appearance", "copy" and "paste" buttons in the dressing room to prevent accidental clicks.
aee-access-unavailable: No active AEE detected (it may be uninstalled or disabled). Extended slots are unavailable.
aee-access-drawing-disabled: AEE is active, but free drawing is disabled. Drawing slots are unavailable.
aee-access-settings-pending: AEE is active, but its free-drawing setting is not available yet. Please wait or check that the other player has updated AEE.
wardrobe-sps-overflow: The legacy wardrobe contains data beyond slot 984. Migration stopped; original data is preserved. Export or reorganize it using the previous version first.
wardrobe-maintenance-failed: Maintenance failed. Keep your backup and reload the wardrobe before retrying.
wardrobe-archive-done: Archive exported: {{n}} records are not referenced by the observed index. Nothing was deleted.
wardrobe-drawing-none: No embedded AEE drawings were found in this wardrobe.
wardrobe-drawing-confirm: Export a wardrobe backup, then upload {{n}} embedded drawings to public SPS image storage? Outfit references will be saved after all uploads succeed. Keep the backup; older AEE versions may not read the new references.
wardrobe-drawing-done: Drawings migrated and wardrobe saved. Keep the downloaded backup.
wardrobe-maintenance-hint: Tools apply to the selected wardrobe. SPS archives can be opened through wardrobe import to choose outfits and destinations. Exporting does not delete data.
wardrobe-drawing-migrate: Back up and migrate old drawings
settings-language-tooltip: Change the language of the AEE interface. "Auto" follows the game's current language.
settings-item-font-tooltip: Choose the font used for text on your own items. Click the button to open the font panel, where you can preview fonts and load custom ones.
settings-toolbar-always-visible-tooltip: On: the side toolbar always stays visible. Off: it stays tucked away until you hover or click it, and closes again when you click elsewhere.
settings-right-click-exit-drag-tooltip: While dragging, rotating, scaling or skewing on the canvas, right-click to stop the current canvas action right away, without opening the browser's context menu.
settings-replace-bc-color-picker-tooltip: Replaces the game's default color panel with the AEE color picker, which adds HSV controls, harmony colors, an eyedropper and saved swatches. Turn off to get the original panel back.
settings-enable-wardrobe-tooltip: Replaces the dressing room's wardrobe with the AEE wardrobe: search, tags, favorites, try-on, photos and export/import, with online, local or SPS storage.
settings-paste-import-tooltip: In the dressing room's clothing list, press Ctrl+V to import a BCX/AEE appearance code from the clipboard and choose what to import. Does nothing while a text field is focused.
settings-enable-copy-paste-tooltip: Shows copy/paste buttons in the clothing list so you can copy a piece with all its settings (colors, offsets, transforms) and paste it into another slot. A cancel button appears at the top of the menu while something is copied.
settings-bc-wheel-scroll-tooltip: In the dressing room's clothing list, scroll the mouse wheel to page through body-part groups instead of clicking the arrow buttons.
settings-hover-item-highlight-tooltip: When you hover a row in the right-hand panel, the matching clothing on the character flashes so you can tell which piece it is.
settings-hover-panel-outline-tooltip: When you hover a row in the right-hand panel, draw an outline around the matching clothing on the character. Works independently of flashing; the color comes from "Outline color" below.
settings-hover-outline-tooltip: Sets the outline color, shared by hover outlines and click-to-pick outlines. Follows the theme color by default, or choose your own.
settings-hover-layer-highlight-tooltip: When you hover a part in AEE's panels (the parts list and the layer manager), the matching layer on the character flashes, which helps you find it in multi-layer items.
settings-hide-lscg-layers-panel-tooltip: When AEE can replace LSCG's opacity tool, hides LSCG's own layers panel so the two don't duplicate each other.
settings-hide-bcx-import-export-tooltip: Hides the appearance import/export buttons that BCX adds at the top of the dressing room. The export/import buttons in AEE's side toolbar are not affected.
settings-hide-arousal-ui-tooltip: Hides the arousal meter and related UI in the dressing room, on the character information sheet, and when interacting with a character in a chat room, for a cleaner view.
hover-tryon-button-on: Hover try-on: on. Click to turn off
hover-tryon-button-off: Hover try-on: off. Click to turn on
character-preview-button-on: Character preview: on. Click to use icon previews
character-preview-button-off: Character preview: off. Click to use character previews
appearance-pick-tooltip: Click to pick: when on, click clothing on the character to open it for editing, with no need to find it in the list. Works only on the dressing room's clothing list
asset-parts-search-tooltip: Part search: find clothing and items by original name, localized name, type or slot, and preview every part and the slots it can appear in
view-control-tooltip: Dressing-room view control: adjust character offset and zoom, the background (solid, grid, image), hide the full-body or close-up preview, and switch poses quickly
settings-button-tooltip: Open AEE settings to turn hover, picking, wardrobe and other features on or off
toolbar-tip-parts: Parts: open the parts list to pick a single part to edit, or choose the whole item to adjust everything at once
toolbar-layer-picker-tip-off-normal: Part picking: off. Click to switch to "Normal", where you click the artwork on the character to select a part
toolbar-layer-picker-tip-off-detail: Part picking: off. Click to switch to "Detail", which shows a label for each part next to the character; click a label to select it
toolbar-layer-picker-tip-normal: Part picking: Normal. Click the artwork on the character to select a part. Click to switch to "Detail"
toolbar-layer-picker-tip-detail: Part picking: Detail. Click a label or the artwork on the character to select a part. Click to turn off
free-transform-tooltip: Free transform: show a control box on the canvas to drag, scale or rotate the selected part directly
toolbar-tip-position: Position: move the selected part. Use the sliders and nudge buttons, or tick "Drag" to move it directly on the canvas
toolbar-tip-rotation: Rotation: rotate the selected part. Fine-tune with the slider, or drag the handle on the canvas
toolbar-tip-scale: Scale: resize the selected part, either proportionally or with width and height set separately
toolbar-tip-skew: Skew: slant the selected part horizontally or vertically. AEE extension; people without AEE won't see the effect
toolbar-tip-mirror: Mirror: flip the selected part horizontally or vertically, or place a mirrored copy of it, with an adjustable mirror axis. AEE extension; people without AEE won't see the effect
toolbar-tip-opacity: Opacity: adjust the transparency of the selected part or the whole item
toolbar-tip-layers: Layers: adjust the draw priority of this item's parts, which decides whether they sit above or below other clothing
toolbar-tip-layering-hide: Layer visibility: choose which clothing groups are hidden while this item is worn. Stored with the outfit and compatible with WCE
toolbar-tip-reset: Reset transforms: restore the selected part's offset, scale, rotation and skew to their defaults
toolbar-tip-mode-neat: Neat mode: tool controls are gathered in the side panel and several can be open at once. Click to switch to free mode
toolbar-tip-mode-free: Free mode: tools open as floating panels over the canvas, with a free-transform control box. Click to switch to neat mode
wardrobe-setting-categories-tooltip: Adds categories and tags to outfits so they are easier to filter and organize
wardrobe-setting-zoom-tooltip: Shows zoom controls in the wardrobe preview so you can enlarge or shrink the character
wardrobe-setting-cancel-tryon-tooltip: After trying on an outfit, shows a revert button that restores how you looked when you entered the wardrobe
wardrobe-setting-portrait-tooltip: When the screen is taller than it is wide (for example a phone held upright), switches to a vertical layout with the panels stacked
wardrobe-setting-confirm-save-tooltip: Asks for confirmation before saving an outfit into a slot, to avoid accidentally overwriting one
wardrobe-setting-shared-tooltip: On: accounts on this device share one local wardrobe. Off: each account keeps its own
wardrobe-setting-sps-tooltip: Lets you choose SPS as a wardrobe storage source. SPS is online storage that can be read across servers
hide-restraints-tip-off: Hide restraints: currently shown. Click to hide them in the preview only; they stay worn, and saving and leaving are unaffected
hide-restraints-tip-on: Hide restraints: hidden in the preview (still worn). Click to show them again
layer-manager-toolbar-tooltip: Layer manager: lists every drawing layer on this character, sorted by priority. Search, filter, and adjust each layer's priority directly
